title: SREV-032 process suspend one

audit_contract.description: API: ProcessServer::SuspendOneHandler | wire: {"request": "PROCESS_SUSPEND_RESUME_ONE_REQ", "header": "MSG_HEADER", "fields": [{"name": "pid", "type": "ULONG", "meaning": "target process id"}, {"name": "suspend", "type": "BOOLEAN", "meaning": "true selects NtSuspendProcess, false selects NtResumeProcess"}]}

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: target process identity and caller authorization must be checked before opening the process
OpenProcess(PROCESS_SUSPEND_RESUME) must return a non-NULL handle before native suspend/resume
NtSuspendProcess and NtResumeProcess receive only a valid opened process handle
CloseHandle is called exactly once for the successfully opened process handle
OpenProcess failure returns STATUS_INVALID_CID before using or closing the handle
